title: God's Promises for Abraham and Sarah
titleZh: 神給亞伯拉罕與撒拉的應許
lines: God's promises for Abraham and Sarah.
神給亞伯拉罕與撒拉的應許。
This is Abram, and he was married to Sarai.
這是亞伯蘭，他娶了撒萊為妻。
When they lived in Canaan, God told Abram he would give him all the land he could see, and that Abram would have as many children as there are stars in the sky.
他們住在迦南時，神告訴亞伯蘭，凡他所看見的地都要賜給他，他的子孫也要多如天上的星。
God said he would bless Abram's family, and they would be a blessing to all people.
神說祂要賜福給亞伯蘭的家，他們也要叫萬民得福。
Many years passed, and Abram and Sarai were very old and still had no children.
過了許多年，亞伯蘭和撒萊年紀老邁，仍然沒有孩子。
God appeared to Abram again and told him his name would now be Abraham, which means father of many nations.
神再次向亞伯蘭顯現，告訴他從今以後要叫亞伯拉罕，意思是「多國之父」。
God also changed Sarai's name to Sarah, and promised to bless Sarah with a son.
神也把撒萊的名字改為撒拉，應許要賜福撒拉，使她生一個兒子。
One day, Abraham was sitting at the entrance to his tent during the hottest part of the day.
有一天，正午最熱的時候，亞伯拉罕坐在帳棚門口。
When the Lord appeared to him, Abraham saw three men standing nearby, and he went to welcome them.
耶和華向他顯現，亞伯拉罕看見有三個人站在附近，就上前迎接他們。
He asked them to stay with him for a while to rest and eat.
他請他們留下來休息一會兒，吃點東西。
So Abraham had Sarah and his servant prepare food for the men.
亞伯拉罕就叫撒拉和僕人為他們預備食物。
When the food was ready, Abraham took the food and served it.
食物預備好了，亞伯拉罕就端去招待他們。
The men asked him, "Where is your wife, Sarah?"
他們問他：「你妻子撒拉在哪裡？」
Abraham said, "Over there in the tent."
Then one of them said, "I will return to you about this time next year. Your wife Sarah will have a son."
其中一位說：「明年這時候我必要回到你這裡，你的妻子撒拉必生一個兒子。」
Sarah was listening to this from the tent.
撒拉在帳棚裡聽見了這話。
She laughed to herself, because she thought it was funny to think that she and Abraham could have a child in their old age.
她心裡暗笑，覺得她和亞伯拉罕這麼老了還能生孩子，實在好笑。
Then the Lord said to Abraham, "Why did Sarah laugh? Is anything too hard for me?"
耶和華對亞伯拉罕說：「撒拉為甚麼笑？耶和華豈有難成的事嗎？」
Sarah was afraid, so she lied and said, "I didn't laugh."
撒拉害怕，就說謊：「我沒有笑。」
But the Lord said, "Yes, you laughed."
耶和華說：「不然，你實在笑了。」
A year later, Sarah did have a son.
一年後，撒拉果然生了一個兒子。
God's promises came true for Abraham and Sarah.
神給亞伯拉罕和撒拉的應許都實現了。
Abraham became the father of many nations.
亞伯拉罕成了多國之父。
And from his child came children, and from their children, more children, until Abraham's descendants were truly more than the stars in the sky, just as the Lord had promised.
從他的孩子生出孩子，孩子又生孩子，直到亞伯拉罕的後裔真的比天上的星還多，正如耶和華所應許的。
